Hi Chloe —

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough this morning. We finished an internal pass on the Whistic profile and identified a handful of outdated controls and evidence files that need pruning before we re-run our CAIQ export. To keep the profile tidy for your reviewers, can Redwood help with two things: 

1) Accept a short CAIQ extract (attached) and map the flagged control IDs to the current profile items. We exported a reduced CSV (caiq-extract-greenfield-20270713.csv) with the controls we consider stale.

2) We need a temporary mechanism to hand off evidence that we can't attach directly to Whistic today — specifically two SOC 2 snapshots and a set of short logs. We can upload to an S3 bucket if you provide pre-signed URLs or a short-lived upload token.

I've attached a SOC 2 snapshot (soc2-snapshot-2026.pdf) and the CAIQ extract for reference. If you need us to sanitize or redact anything first, let us know. We have a compliance window next week and would like the profile trimmed by EOD Thu (2027-07-15) if possible.

Next steps we propose:
- You confirm whether Redwood can accept a CSV mapping and a set of pre-signed upload URLs.
- We will upload the artifacts to the provided destination and mark the old attachments as archived.

Thanks — appreciate the help.

Sara Lee
Sr. Security Program Manager
Greenfield Labs

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the export, that helps. We can take the CSV and produce a mapping file that aligns the flagged control IDs to the current Whistic fields we maintain. Two quick notes:

- For the SOC 2 snapshot and any log bundles, pre-signed S3 uploads are the easiest for us to accept. We can provide time-limited PUT URLs scoped to a Greenfield Labs folder and then import the files into our evidence staging bucket.
- We generally avoid storing raw logs in Whistic; if the files are small (under 200MB) we can host an evidence stub link and attach a provenance note. If larger, the staging bucket + signed URL works best.

Action items from our side:
- Mina will prepare the CAIQ->Whistic mapping and return a short delta mapping CSV.
- Ben will create a set of pre-signed S3 upload URLs (72-hour validity) and a temporary credentials text file for your S3 client (we'll send that to the security@ address).
- I'll coordinate the profile update once uploads are complete and will mark the old evidence as archived in Whistic so reviewers see the pruned set.

We aim to have the mapping and upload URLs by EOD today (14 Jul). If that slips, we'll push to 15 Jul morning.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Security Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
